title: Route a customer message
context: You answer support email for an online shop. Billing reviews charges, and security handles personal details shown to the wrong person.
case: My invoice page shows a bill for Dana Okafor, card ending 4411. That is my name. There is a $40 charge I don't recognize.
question: Where do you send this message?

options.text: Back to the customer for more detail

explanation: The bill is the customer's own, so this is a question about a charge. Billing reviews it.

changes.explanation: The customer saw another person's name and card digits. Those are personal details shown to the wrong person, so the message goes to security.
A larger amount is still a charge on the customer's own bill, so the message goes to billing.

rule: A message goes to security when the customer saw someone else's details, and to billing when the charge is on their own bill, whatever the amount.
